LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking Phonological awareness Sound discrimination, initials and
Topic 1.1: Phonological Awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonological Awareness, part of Listening and Speaking Phonological awareness Sound discrimination, initials and in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is correct articulation of words important in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen and repeat saying initials and finals from a recording (z, c, s, zh, ch, sh, r, w, y,ai ,ei, ui ,ou ,iu, ie, ü ,un, an, en, ang, eng, ing, ong),

2. identify initials and finals from the given syllables and say them out( 你、我、他/她、朋、友、叫、 什么、名字、是、不、女孩、男 孩 ),

3. introduce themselves with the correct tones (hello+ name +age+ gender i.e. 你/您好,我叫......,你呢? ......),

4. listen to an introduction of a friend and respond to the questions (我朋 友叫什么名字? 他是不是女孩、 男孩?),

5. take turns introducing their friend by their name, age and gender (e.g. 我朋 友叫......。他是男生。),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat saying initials and finals from a recording (z, c, s, zh, ch, sh, r, w, y,ai ,ei, ui ,ou ,iu, ie, ü ,un, an, en, ang, eng, ing, ong),
2. identify initials and finals from the given syllables and say them out( 你、我、他/她、朋、友、叫、 什么、名字、是、不、女孩、男 孩 ),
3. introduce themselves with the correct tones (hello+ name +age+ gender i.e. 你/您好,我叫......,你呢? ......),
4. listen to an introduction of a friend and respond to the questions (我朋 友叫什么名字? 他是不是女孩、 男孩?),
5. take turns introducing their friend by their name, age and gender (e.g. 我朋 友叫......。他是男生。),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Phonological Awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork skills are exhibited when the learner actively identifies rhyming and non- rhyming syllables and words collaboratively.

Values:
Patriotism: This is enhanced when the learner is aware of their social and moral duties as members of the community to use

respectful language when making introductions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social awareness skills: The learner understands and follows social norms and expectations as they make introductions with

respect and using the appropriate titles.

Link to other learning areas:

● The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili on the use of appropriate pronouns in varied contexts.

● Learning is linked to English and Kiswahili on the use of appropriate vocabulary to express their ideas and opinions in a

logical manner.
